text:
Maria Chen: dropped a variant that collapses the sampling control into the p95 header to save vertical space. mock: https://redwood.design/mock/2151234567-compact.png. goal: keep card height stable, make density obvious without a full slider. thoughts?

Ben Ortiz: minor yess. question on affordance: is it still discoverable without a label? maybe a small chevron to expand. Also we need to decide whether the compact control should show percent or tags (Dense / Default / Sparse).

Elaine Park: discoverability: include a tooltip on hover and an inline label for a11y. copy suggestion: label as `Sampling density` and helper text `Higher density = more accurate p95, higher cost`. For compact view show `🔘 55%` rather than words.

Sunil Rao: infra considerations: collapsed controls reduce layout churn, but expanding could request immediate re-sampling. Recommend collapsing be client-only until confirm/commit to avoid extra aggregation calls. Also add debounce + coalesce (500ms) on commits from the same session.

Kai Liu: accessibility nits: collapsed control must be reachable with keyboard nav and announced. Use `aria-haspopup` on the toggle and a visually-hidden `aria-live` region that says "Sampling density set to X percent". Contrast check: compact chip uses 3.2:1 currently. Need >=4.5 for body text.

Maria Chen: ok on aria-live. For UI animation, prefer 150ms fade for expand/collapse. On legend: when density <20% we should show a warning tooltip: "Low sampling may omit rare tail events."

Ben Ortiz: charts: for heatmap bucket changes when density changes, we should smooth histogram bin heights via crossfade and hold y-axis max for 1s while new samples stream in. prevents the bar from jumping and confusing users.

Elaine Park: keyboard step sizes: arrow keys: 1%, PageUp/Down: 10%, Home/End to min/max. Also focus ring: 3px solid focus color + 6px touch halo for mobile.

Sunil Rao: backend throttle: if commit rate > 4 per second from a session, reject intermediate commits with 429 and return suggestion to batch. We'll also emit a metric `client.sampling.commit.rate` to watch.

Ava (design-bot): auto-lint: compact chip contrast 3.2 (fail). recommended label copy variants: ["Sampling density","Sampling intensity","Sample density"]. Suggest using `aria-live=\"polite\"` for updates and `role=\"slider\"` for the control when expanded.

Maria Chen: thanks. action items: 1) Ben implement compact toggle + aria attributes, preserve client-only preview, coalesce commit (500ms). 2) Kai to produce accessible microcopy and a11y QA checklist. 3) Elaine to finalize helper tooltip copy and low-density warning copy. 4) Sunil to add gateway coalesce + throttle rule and metric. I'll post hi-fi with the fade animation before Friday.

Ben Ortiz: picking this up. I'll also add e2e that asserts no layout shift on p95 card when toggling control.

Kai Liu: I'll draft the microcopy: "Sampling density — how many requests we include in aggregated latency metrics. Increase for accuracy, decrease to save compute." Posting in doc shortly.

Maria Chen: perfect, thanks team. leaving this open for design review on Thu. :sparkles:
